requirements.title: Inclusive growth, sustainable development and well-being
requirements.requirementText: Stakeholders should proactively engage in responsible stewardship of trustworthy AI in pursuit of beneficial outcomes for people and the planet, such as augmenting human capabilities and enhancing creativity, advancing inclusion of underrepresented populations, reducing economic, social, gender and other inequalities, and protecting natural environments, thus enriching quality of life.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Responsible stewardship for beneficial outcomes
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should encourage the development, deployment and use of AI systems that are innovative and trustworthy and that respect human rights and democratic values, with the aim of fostering inclusion, sustainability, human well-being and economic growth.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Sustainable development alignment
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should consider potential long-term societal and environmental impacts of AI systems, including resource use and energy consumption, and seek to ensure that AI systems contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Human-centred values and fairness
requirements.requirementText: Throughout the AI system lifecycle, stakeholders should respect the rule of law, human rights and democratic values, and implement mechanisms and safeguards, such as capacity for human determination, that are appropriate to the context and consistent with the state of art.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Respect for rule of law and human rights
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should respect the rule of law, human rights, and democratic values throughout the AI system lifecycle. These include freedom, dignity and autonomy, privacy and data protection, non-discrimination and equality, diversity, fairness, social justice, and internationally recognised labour rights.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Fairness and non-discrimination
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should implement mechanisms and safeguards, such as capacity for human agency and oversight, that are appropriate to the context and consistent with the state of art, to ensure that AI systems do not create or reinforce unfair bias or discrimination.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Human agency and oversight
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should ensure that AI systems are designed and implemented in a way that respects human agency and oversight, including through mechanisms for human intervention, override, and shutdown where appropriate.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Transparency and explainability
requirements.requirementText: AI Actors should commit to transparency and responsible disclosure regarding AI systems. With regard to AI systems, transparency can mean different things in different contexts. It can include providing clear information about the AI system, its capabilities and limitations, and the data used to train and operate it.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Transparency and disclosure
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should provide meaningful information, appropriate to the context, and consistent with the state of art to foster a general understanding of AI systems, to make stakeholders aware of their interactions with AI systems, and to enable those affected by an AI system to understand the outcome and, if applicable, the decision-making process.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Explainability
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should, based on their roles, the context, and their ability to act, apply the principles of transparency and responsible disclosure, and provide information that enables people to understand when they are interacting with an AI system and to comprehend the outcome and, where applicable, the decision-making process of the AI system.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Robustness, security and safety
requirements.requirementText: AI systems should be robust, secure and safe throughout their entire lifecycle so that, under normal use, they function appropriately and do not pose unreasonable safety risk.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Robustness and safety throughout lifecycle
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should ensure that AI systems are robust and safe throughout their entire lifecycle, including through ongoing testing, monitoring, and validation, and that they do not pose unreasonable safety risks under normal use conditions.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Security and risk management
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should ensure that AI systems are secure and resilient to attacks, and that risks are identified, assessed, and managed throughout the AI system lifecycle, including through contingency planning and fallback mechanisms.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Contingency and fallback
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should ensure that AI systems have fallback plans and contingency mechanisms to handle failures, and that critical AI systems can be overridden or deactivated by humans when necessary.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should be accountable for the proper functioning of AI systems and for the respect of the above principles, based on their roles, the context, and consistent with the state of art.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Organisational accountability
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should be accountable for the proper functioning of AI systems and for the respect of the above principles, based on their roles, the context, and consistent with the state of art.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Redress mechanisms
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should ensure that mechanisms exist for those affected by AI systems to seek redress, including through accessible and effective grievance and remediation processes.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence

requirements.title: Reporting and disclosure of incidents
requirements.requirementText: AI actors should report information about AI systems that is relevant to accountability, including when AI systems may cause or have caused harm, and cooperate with relevant authorities and stakeholders.
requirements.sourceDocument: OECD Council Recommendation on Artificial Intelligence
